children: may extend its bounce into a range of $91.82 to $92.53 per barrel, as suggested by a channel technique and a projection analysis.

The upper channel line points at the zone formed by the 23.6% and the 14.6% projection levels of a wave (c) from $93.69. Strategically, the zone will be confirmed when the market breaks an immediate resistance at $90.66.
A break below $89.72 may trigger a fall into the $87.62-$88.78 range. On the daily chart, the market climbed into a triangle after briefly falling below it.
Although the wedge formed after a downtrend, it may not necessarily be a bearish pattern. With the market rising above $90.02, the triangle may turn out to be bullish.
